title: Gift of Oinky Poinky
body:
Trade-only
This item is no longer available unless by means of trading with another player.

"Experience the adorable and whimsical world of Oinky Poinky with this charming gift."

Description

Limited item in 2023 Christmas Update. When unboxed, gives a box, which you can unbox to get a painting of Gurt.

Trivia

On Christmas when this gift became openable, the box it would open into would have a count of 'xnil', however, upon reload, it appears that this count would disappear. This did not affect the placing of the item. When the structure was placed, it would be immovable.
